# Camp Resource: Americana Nuka Cola Mystery Machine

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 11, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_45f77c3fe84a4139b4be9b9109698402~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

This Americana inspired Nuka-Cola Machine holds every Nuka-Cola variety you could ever want! But which one will you get?

Be warned, there is a 5 minute restocking period before you will be able to quench your thirst again.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Americana Nuka Cola Mystery Machine__

Image Credit: DSJ

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1ac4513371054abd936689b087b16d67~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Nuka-Cola Cranberry - 1.5%

Nuka-Cola Quantum - 1.5%

Nuka-Cola Dark - 1.5%

Nuka-Cherry - 3.62%

Nuka-Grape - 3.62%

Nuka-Cola Orange - 3.62%

Nuka-Cola Wild - 3.62%

Nuka-Cola - 40.5%

Nuka-Cola Twist - 40.5%

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine, Classic Nuka Cola Mystery Machine

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

1x Gears

2x Springs

3x Steel

**Holds**

N/A

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

5 min (300 seconds) cooldown period.

**Lockable**

15 caps per use

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
